title.zh: 修订第136号法案第三十三条，规定最高法院判决报告须以英文与西班牙文两种语言出版，但每种语言的判决应分别装订成册，而非如现行法律所规定的合订一册的法案
title.en: AN ACT SO AMENDING SECTION THIRTY-THREE OF ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND THIRTY-SIX AS TO PROVIDE THAT THE REPORTS OF THE DECISIONS OF THE SUPREME COURT SHALL BE PUBLISHED IN BOTH THE ENGLISH AND SPANISH LANGUAGES, BUT THAT THE DECISIONS IN EACH LANGUAGE SHALL BE BOUND SEPARATELY INSTEAD OF IN THE SAME VOLUME, AS NOW PROVIDED BY LAW.

title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Điều ba mươi ba của Đạo luật số một trăm ba mươi sáu nhằm quy định báo cáo các phán quyết của Tòa án Tối cao phải được xuất bản bằng cả tiếng Anh và tiếng Tây Ban Nha, nhưng các phán quyết bằng mỗi ngôn ngữ phải được đóng thành tập riêng thay vì cùng một tập như hiện nay

title.id: Undang-Undang yang Mengubah Pasal Tiga Puluh Tiga dari Undang-Undang Nomor Seratus Tiga Puluh Enam guna Menetapkan bahwa Laporan Putusan Mahkamah Agung harus Diterbitkan dalam Bahasa Inggris dan Spanyol, tetapi Putusan dalam Setiap Bahasa Harus Dijilid Secara Terpisah, bukan dalam Satu Volume seperti yang Diatur oleh Undang-Undang Saat Ini
title.ms: Akta yang Mengubah Bahagian Tiga Puluh Tiga Akta Nombor Seratus Tiga Puluh Enam supaya Laporan Keputusan Mahkamah Agung hendaklah diterbitkan dalam bahasa Inggeris dan Sepanyol tetapi keputusan dalam setiap bahasa hendaklah dijilid secara berasingan dan bukan dalam satu jilid seperti yang ditetapkan oleh undang-undang semasa

text.en:
Section thirty-three of Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-six, entitled "An Act providing for
the organization of courts in the Philippine Islands," is hereby amended so as to read as follows:
"Section 33. In what language cases reported.-Until the first day of January, nineteen hundred and six, each
case shall be reported in both the English and Spanish languages, and the decisions shall be bound in
separate volumes, one volume containing the decisions in the English language and the other in the Spanish
language. After the first day of January, nineteen hundred and six, the decisions shall be published only in the
English language."

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act. shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, April 4, 1904.
